message: サリーちゃんの日常

name: Ria
message: 「The tea will be ready soon~. We'll eat the snacks together after that, okay?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Haaah~, so relaxing~. Ria-senpai's tea always smells so good~, zzz--」

name: Synn
message: 「N-Nanaka, you look like you're about to doze off before snack time」

name: Ria
message: 「Hehehe」

name: Sally
message: 「Prez, hey-o!」

name: Synn
message: 「Sally-chan, lured in by the smell again, huh? Still, you shouldn't come in through the window」

name: Sally
message: 「Sorr~y. But Ria's tea is the signal for snacks! As part of the Delicious Food Squad, I just can't pass it up!」

name: Sally
message: 「Ufufunofu~, wha-wha-what could today's snack be~♪」

name: Paqy
message: 「Jeez, quit coming around just to mooch free food, ya hear? You only work your part-time gig at the beef bowl joint when you're starving anyway, right, Flatty?」

name: Sally
message: 「You're pretty much the same as me, Paqy. If you're gonna talk like that, fork over something good」

name: Paqy
message: 「Sure thing? Hold out your hand」

name: Sally
message: 「Yessir♪ Ooh, ooh, ooh」

name: Paqy
message: 「Ptui, ptui!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Hey, Paqy!!」

name: Sally
message: 「Heyyy!! What do you think you're doing to the idol of the Demon World, you black-moldy daifuku mochi!!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Bwah!!」

name: Paqy
message: 「You did it now!? Prepare yourself, you little punk!!」

name: Sally
message: 「Oww!」

name: Sally
message: 「I won't forgive you, I'm gonna use you as a filthy rag at the beef bowl shop!!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Right back at ya--I'll turn you into a train and bus strap so you're actually useful to people!」

name: Sally
message: 「Grrr--!」

name: Synn
message: 「A little imp and a Great Sage are fighting on equal footing...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「They say the more you fight, the closer you are.」
Ria-senpai opens the door. Sally-chan and Paqy, trading blows with their fists, tumble over each other out toward the hallway

name: Ria
message: 「Heeey now. Kids who fight get sentenced to no snacks as punishment.」

name: Sally
message: 「Ugh, *sniff*. Waaaaah! I wanna eat sweets too!」

name: Ria
message: 「No way! Reflect on what you've done!」
I-I'm starting to feel kind of bad for her.
Paqy was the one who picked the fight first anyway, which ultimately makes it my responsibility as his roommate.

name: Synn
message: 「S-Senpai, um, you see...」
I worked hard to persuade Senpai, and then ate snacks together with Sally-chan.
Surprisingly, Paqy shared half of his own sweets with Sally-chan. He must be regretting that he went too far.
